name: FAQ
content:
Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a typical project take?

It depends on the work. A weekly mowing visit is the same day each week; a mulch or bed refresh is usually a day; a paver patio runs two to five days depending on size and access. We give you a clear timeline with your estimate.

Do you offer recurring service or just one-time jobs?

Both. Most clients set up recurring weekly or bi-weekly lawn maintenance, often bundled with seasonal cleanups and snow removal. We also handle one-time projects like patios, plantings, tree work, and cleanups.

Are you licensed and insured?

Absolutely. We carry full general liability and workers' compensation coverage, and we're happy to provide a certificate of insurance on request.

Do you serve commercial properties?

Yes. We maintain residential yards as well as commercial grounds, HOA common areas, and commercial snow and ice management with the reliability and documentation those accounts need.

What if I'm not happy with the work?

We come back and make it right — a missed strip, an edge we didn't catch, cleanup we didn't finish. Tell us and we'll handle it, no charge and no runaround.
heroDescription: Get answers to common questions about our services.
